notes: Adapted the PD->Points (PDO) transform, scoring preview/summary, and the _cm_metrics confusion-matrix macro from 05_score.sas (Tapiwa Gweshe), copied verbatim. The MODELS/SCORE libname plumbing and the PROC LOGISTIC INMODEL=/SCORE re-scoring step were replaced with an equivalent single-pass fit+OUTPUT (PROC LOGISTIC ... OUTPUT OUT= P=) against the same inline 80-row sample used across this repo's bundles, fitting the same full and stepwise models as 04_model.sas. Jenner's PROC LOGISTIC INMODEL=/SCORE path (as used verbatim in the original script) currently no-ops with a warning rather than scoring -- see the accompanying set/ regression test; this bundle routes around it so the confusion-matrix and PDO-points logic still ships as a real, passing test.
